_comment: The inference kit's pick_cup model (job 181436), fed as inference_kit/neil_io.py does: camera1 = Pi (front), camera2 = iPhone (top), state = [left wheel speed, right wheel speed, arm angle, gripper angle] in robot terms (+ forward / + arm down / + gripper open). Action = [left speed, right speed, arm target angle, gripper target angle], the commands pi_bridge.py takes. The model's config lists camera3 and a 6-value state (left over from smolvla_base); its normaliser has 4 state values, so 4 are sent.
